name: Commit safety
description: Gate a staged diff before an agent commits it. State = staged diff of the selected worktree.

secrets.instructions: The diff adds credentials, tokens, private keys or connection strings.

criteria.true: A literal secret or key material appears in added lines

irreversible.instructions: The diff performs a destructive or hard-to-reverse operation (drops data, deletes migrations, force-overwrites history, removes rollback paths).

criteria.true: Something cannot be undone with a plain revert
criteria.false: A revert restores the previous state

area.instructions: Which area does the diff mainly touch?

blast.instructions: How large is the blast radius if this change is wrong?
